portals.name: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Cilacap
portals.observation: Cilacap Regency JDIH documents identify the local Kantor Pertanahan. The separately inspected WebGIS shell is branded as that office but includes contradictory Toboali/Bangka Selatan news and its exposed layer is mining permits; I therefore treat that GIS as unverified and do not infer parcel coverage from it.

requests.observation: Public QGIS shell HTTP 200. Inspected Export_Output_5_0.js header and first feature showed mining-permit fields/features from Bangka Belitung, not cadastral parcels.
